assumptions: Visual evidence: 64 frames at 640x480. About 410 image tokens per frame assumes tokens = width*height/750. Unverified for current models; measure with count_tokens before any run.
Text scaffold (system, question, text evidence and timestamps) is about 900 tokens. Visual cells add about 26,250 image tokens plus 768 timestamp-label tokens.
Output: about 600 tokens assumed (adaptive thinking plus JSON), capped at 2,048. Thinking cannot be disabled on Claude Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 and is billed as output.
No prompt caching or batch discount in the headline. Frames are placed first, so the 12 visual-bearing requests of one example can share a cached prefix; that scenario is reported separately.
Episode counts depend on adjudicated Stage 1 groups. 150 eval episodes is the target, not an observation.
